Docs.summary: Represents the result of an asynchronous pixel read-back request.

remarks.format:
## Remarks
An <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult> is passed to the callback of an asynchronous pixel read-back request, such as <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImage.RequestReadPixels%2A> or <xref:SkiaSharp.SKSurface.RequestReadPixels%2A>. The result, and any spans obtained from it, are only valid for the duration of the callback. Accessing the result after the callback returns throws an <xref:System.ObjectDisposedException>.
If you need to retain the pixels beyond the callback, copy them out with <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult.ToArray%2A>, <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult.ToImage%2A>, or <xref:SkiaSharp.SKImageReadPixelsResult.ToBitmap%2A>.
